{{Intro/Quest|Dreamweaver's Ascent}}

==Summary==
At Gourmet Street, you discuss your dream involving the Sentinel and Mt. Firmament. A fellow diner shares insights about the mountain, and Abby senses a strange aura emanating from the southeast. Together, you resolve to seek information about the Sentinel at the City Hall. 

In City Hall, Sanhua reveals that the Magistrate ventured to Mt. Firmament days ago, concerned for the Sentinel's safety. You express your intent to follow and Sanhua offers to contact a guide for the treacherous journey. She arranges a meeting with the Wayfinder at Whining Aix's Mire.

==Steps==
# Head to the Gourmet Street
# Head to City Hall
# Head to the Meeting Room
# Leave City Hall

==Dialogue ==
{{Quest Description|Your forgotten past, hazy memories, and a strange dream... So many questions linger about your identity, and who you used to be. Meanwhile, a mysterious pull guides you to a hidden place on the distant sea...}}
{{Dialogue Start}}
;(Upon obtaining quest)
:'''Abby:''' [[Rover]], did you hear that? My stomach is growling.
:'''Abby:''' Ugh... I'm sooo hungry...
:'''Abby:''' How about we go to that place we went to last time with [[Yangyang]] and [[Chixia]]?
:'''Abby:''' I love their food so much!
----
:{{A|Vo mtfrmmq 1_1_5_1.ogg}} '''Abby:''' Mmm... Yummy, yummy!
:{{A|Vo mtfrmmq 1_1_5_2.ogg}} '''Abby:''' Hello? Are you with me? {{Rover}}, you seem a bit distracted.
:{{A|Vo mtfrmmq 1_1_5_3.ogg}} '''Abby:''' With so much delicious food right in front of you, aren't you gonna try any? Well if you're not interested, I'll gobble it all up!
:{{A|Vo mtfrmmq 1_1_5_4.ogg}} '''Abby:''' You've been absent-minded the whole day. Still bothered by that dream from last night?
:{{A|Vo mtfrmmq 1_1_5_5.ogg}} '''Abby:''' Wait, so you had a dream about the [[Jué|Sentinel]]? Like the one from your flashback when we saw the [[Sentinel]] statue after you lost your memory?
:{{DIcon}} This time, I saw more.
:{{DIcon}} This time, I saw something different.
:{{A|Vo mtfrmmq 1_1_5_8.ogg}} '''Abby:''' Hang on, let me get this straight... The Sentinel swooshed you off to a mountain shaped like a dragon...
:{{A|Vo mtfrmmq 1_1_5_9.ogg}} '''Abby:''' And then there were all these bad things going on with lots and lots of [[Tacet Discord]]s, but the Sentinel saved the day!       
:{{A|Vo mtfrmmq 1_1_5_10.ogg}} '''Abby:''' How exactly did it protect everyone again... Oh, in your dream it made the time different there?
:{{A|Vo mtfrmmq 1_1_5_11_M.ogg}} {{A|Vo mtfrmmq 1_1_5_11_F.ogg}} '''Rover:''' Yeah... The time in the mountains seemed to have slowed down from the outside, away from the Tacet Discords.
:{{A|Vo mtfrmmq 1_1_5_12_M.ogg}} {{A|Vo mtfrmmq 1_1_5_12_F.ogg}} '''Rover:''' The Sentinel must have created a barrier by manipulating the flow of time, keeping those monsters out.
:{{A|Vo mtfrmmq 1_1_5_13_M.ogg}} {{A|Vo mtfrmmq 1_1_5_13_F.ogg}} '''Rover:''' It was a safe haven from all the disturbances caused by the Tacet Discords, where people lived peacefully...
:{{A|Vo mtfrmmq 1_1_5_14_M.ogg}} {{A|Vo mtfrmmq 1_1_5_14_F.ogg}} '''Rover:''' Also... In my dream, I wasn't affected by the slowed time and could freely move in and out of the barrier.
:{{A|Vo mtfrmmq 1_1_5_15.ogg}} '''Abby:''' It's no shock that you have awesome powers, being friends with me.
:{{A|Vo mtfrmmq 1_1_5_16.ogg}} '''Abby:''' Hmm... What was that place you dreamed about called?
:{{A|Vo mtfrmmq 1_1_5_17_M.ogg}} {{A|Vo mtfrmmq 1_1_5_17_F.ogg}} '''Rover:''' I'm not entirely sure I heard it correctly, but in my dream, the Sentinel mentioned a place called [[Mt. Firmament]].
:{{A|Vo mtfrmmq 1_1_5_18.ogg}} '''Abby:''' Mt. Firmament? Never heard of it...      
:{{A|Vo mtfrmmq 1_1_5_19_M.ogg}} {{A|Vo mtfrmmq 1_1_5_19_F.ogg}} '''Jiusi:''' You never heard of Mt. Firmament? Then I'm sure you're not from around here.
:{{A|Vo mtfrmmq 1_1_5_20.ogg}} '''Abby:''' Hold on! Did you just say Mt. Firmament?!
:{{A|Vo mtfrmmq 1_1_5_21.ogg}} '''Jiusi:''' Oh my! Did that [[Echo]] just... talk?
:{{DIcon}} It's a good friend of mine.
:{{DIcon}} Relax. It won't hurt you.
:{{A|Vo mtfrmmq 1_1_5_24.ogg}} '''Qingxiang:''' Come on, man, relax. You don't hear an Echo talking every day, but it's not that uncommon either!
:{{A|Vo mtfrmmq 1_1_5_25.ogg}} '''Qingxiang:''' I heard there's a country called Ri... Rinas... What? Anyway, the Echoes there are next level.
:{{DIcon}} What's up with this Mt. Firmament?
:{{A|Vo mtfrmmq 1_1_5_27_M.ogg}} {{A|Vo mtfrmmq 1_1_5_27_F.ogg}} '''Qingxiang:''' Oh, you're not from around here? Well, that explains why you don't know about Mt. Firmament.
:{{A|Vo mtfrmmq 1_1_5_28.ogg}} '''Qingxiang:''' Legends say Mt. Firmament is where the first people of [[Jinzhou]] lived. It looks like a giant statue of our Sentinel Jué. 
:{{A|Vo mtfrmmq 1_1_5_29.ogg}} '''Qingxiang:''' I've never heard of anyone going to that place. They say those who try either get lost in the sea mist or never come back.
:{{A|Vo mtfrmmq 1_1_5_30.ogg}} '''Qingxiang:''' If you're curious, just head southeast. Mt. Firmament is on the east side of [[Whining Aix's Mire]], and you can see it from a distance.
:{{A|Vo mtfrmmq 1_1_5_31.ogg}} '''Abby:''' The southeast...
:{{A|Vo mtfrmmq 1_1_5_33.ogg}} '''Abby:''' The past few days, especially this morning, I caught this unique smell from the southeast. From that mountain they just mentioned.
:{{DIcon}} A unique smell... What do you mean?
:{{A|Vo mtfrmmq 1_1_5_35.ogg}} '''Abby:''' It's like a strong energy pulsing through the air, but I can't quite put my finger on it. It feels kind of weird though, doesn't smell natural...
:{{A|Vo mtfrmmq 1_1_5_36.ogg}} '''Abby:''' Could it have anything to do with what you said? A place where time passes slowly?
:{{A|Vo mtfrmmq 1_1_5_37.ogg}} '''Abby:''' Hmm... Do you wanna go check it out?
:{{A|Vo mtfrmmq 1_1_5_38_M.ogg}} {{A|Vo mtfrmmq 1_1_5_38_F.ogg}} '''Rover:''' I had a flashback about seeing their Sentinel... Perhaps that happened on Mt. Firmament...
:{{A|Vo mtfrmmq 1_1_5_39_M.ogg}} {{A|Vo mtfrmmq 1_1_5_39_F.ogg}} '''Rover:''' I can feel an unknown force guiding me, urging me to go there and find something...       
:{{A|Vo mtfrmmq 1_1_5_40_M.ogg}} {{A|Vo mtfrmmq 1_1_5_40_F.ogg}} '''Rover:''' Jinhsi said she'll go search for the Sentinel and update me on its whereabouts.
:{{A|Vo mtfrmmq 1_1_5_41_M.ogg}} {{A|Vo mtfrmmq 1_1_5_41_F.ogg}} '''Rover:''' But so far, I have not heard anything from the [[City Hall]] yet...
:{{A|Vo mtfrmmq 1_1_5_42.ogg}} '''Abby:''' Then... Shall we go check it out together? It feels really suspicious.
:{{DIcon}} Let's go ask [[Jinhsi]] about it.

:'''Rover:''' Abby, are you getting sleepy again?
:'''Abby:''' Let me... take a quick nap, all right? I've got keen ears. If anything goes down, just give me a holler, and I'll be... I'll be up in a jiffy... I swear...

----
:{{A|Vo mtfrmmq 1_1_15_1.ogg}} '''Sanhua:''' Greetings, {{Rover}}.
:{{A|Vo mtfrmmq 1_1_15_2.ogg}} '''Sanhua:''' What can I help you with today?
:{{DIcon}} I'm here for Jinhsi. I have questions about the Sentinel.
:{{A|Vo mtfrmmq 1_1_15_4.ogg}} '''Sanhua:''' I regret to inform you that Madam Magistrate is not in the City Hall. She has left for Mt. Firmament.
:{{A|Vo mtfrmmq 1_1_15_5.ogg}} '''Sanhua:''' In fact... We have not heard back from her for days.
:{{DIcon}} So you don't know what she is up to?
:{{A|Vo mtfrmmq 1_1_15_7.ogg}} '''Sanhua:''' Unfortunately, no... Please keep this confidential. The situation in Jinzhou is still unstable after our battle with the [[Threnodian]]. We must limit discussion of the Magistrate's whereabouts to a select few. 
:{{DIcon}} What's going on?
:{{A|Vo mtfrmmq 1_1_15_9.ogg}} '''Sanhua:''' When we captured [[Scar]], he claimed that the [[Fractsidus]] had imprisoned our Sentinel.
:{{A|Vo mtfrmmq 1_1_15_10.ogg}} '''Sanhua:''' It was around the same time that Madam Magistrate lost track of Sentinel Jué.
:{{A|Vo mtfrmmq 1_1_15_11.ogg}} '''Sanhua:''' If our Sentinel is truly in danger... Or if someone with malicious intent obtains this information, the potential consequences could be as catastrophic as the previous Threnodian invasion.
:{{A|Vo mtfrmmq 1_1_15_12.ogg}} '''Sanhua:''' In order to investigate the Sentinel's whereabouts, Madam Magistrate has left for Mt. Firmament, its last recorded location.
:{{DIcon}} Did Jinhsi bring anyone with her? Bodyguards? Can you get in touch with them?
:{{A|Vo mtfrmmq 1_1_15_14.ogg}} '''Sanhua:''' Madam Magistrate traveled to Mt. Firmament alone.
:{{A|Vo mtfrmmq 1_1_15_15.ogg}} '''Sanhua:''' The looming threat of the Threnodian discouraged any additional diversion of human resources. Furthermore, when it comes to the Sentinel... Force is not a viable solution.
:{{DIcon}} I need to go to Mt. Firmament to meet with the Sentinel.
:{{DIcon}} Jinhsi might be in trouble, and I want to help.
:{{A|Vo mtfrmmq 1_1_15_18.ogg}} '''Sanhua:''' Madam Magistrate trusts you. It is beyond my authorization to meddle in your decisions.
:{{A|Vo mtfrmmq 1_1_15_19.ogg}} '''Sanhua:''' However, the landscape around Mt. Firmament is complex. One must be accompanied by a special "Wayfinder" to navigate safely. That's all I know.
:{{DIcon}} Where can I find this Wayfinder, then?
:{{A|Vo mtfrmmq 1_1_15_21.ogg}} '''Sanhua:''' Currently... She's likely at the ferry terminal in Whining Aix's Mire. I'll reach out to her.
:{{A|Vo mtfrmmq 1_1_15_22.ogg}} '''Sanhua:''' To learn more about Mt. Firmament, you can meet her at the ferry. I lack the same level of understanding of the situation there as she does.
:{{DIcon}} All right.
:{{A|Vo mtfrmmq 1_1_15_24.ogg}} '''Sanhua:''' I trust Madam Magistrate's decisions. I will do my utmost to handle the public matters on her behalf while she is away.   
:{{A|Vo mtfrmmq 1_1_15_25.ogg}} '''Sanhua:''' I just... This worry about her safety won't leave me.
:{{A|Vo mtfrmmq 1_1_15_26.ogg}} '''Sanhua:''' In her last video message, I could tell she seemed weaker than usual, despite her efforts to maintain composure.
:{{A|Vo mtfrmmq 1_1_15_27.ogg}} '''Sanhua:''' Madam Magistrate's situation might not be optimistic...
:{{A|Vo mtfrmmq 1_1_15_28.ogg}} '''Sanhua:''' {{Rover}}, Mt. Firmament is a dangerous place. Please take care.
:{{A|Vo mtfrmmq 1_1_15_29.ogg}} '''Sanhua:''' I have sent the coordinates to your terminal. Thank you for your kind help... I pray you will both return safely.
:{{DIcon}} (Abby.)
:{{DIcon}} (Abby, are you there?)
:{{A|Vo mtfrmmq 1_1_15_32.ogg}} '''Abby:''' I'm here.
:{{A|Vo mtfrmmq 1_1_15_34.ogg}} '''Abby:''' Hey, did you notice how the mountain has a strangely pleasant smell? It doesn't look edible though...
:{{DIcon}} Are you hungry again?
::'''Abby:''' Not that I'm hungry or anything. I just tend to doze off easily. Feels like my body can only process what I consume while sleeping.
:{{DIcon}} I'm suddenly unsure whether I can count on you.
::{{A|Vo mtfrmmq 1_1_15_39.ogg}} '''Abby:''' Well of course I'm reliable! Even if I do happen to fall asleep and can't hear you...
:{{DIcon}} Go get some rest. I can handle it.
::'''Abby:''' Of course you can! When I'm already so cool. you must be pretty amazing too!
:{{A|Vo mtfrmmq 1_1_15_41.ogg}} '''Abby:''' And don't worry, if there's any danger coming your way, I'll wake up like clockwork, just like last time.
:{{A|Vo mtfrmmq 1_1_15_42.ogg}} '''Abby:''' Well, unless there's nothing that can even remotely challenge you.
:{{A|Vo mtfrmmq 1_1_15_43.ogg}} '''Abby:''' In that case, I probably won't... wake... up...
----
:{{A|Vo mtfrmmq 1_1_25_1_M.ogg}} {{A|Vo mtfrmmq 1_1_25_1_F.ogg}} '''Rover:''' Let's head to the ferry.
:{{A|Vo mtfrmmq 1_1_25_2_M.ogg}} {{A|Vo mtfrmmq 1_1_25_2_F.ogg}} '''Rover:''' Hmm... Mt. Firmament... Our Wayfinder should have plenty information to share.
{{Dialogue End}}
